items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And you're sure it wasn't George James?

ctx.x: He was a very light-skinned boy, a great musician -- he was in the studios for awhile.
And you're sure it wasn't George James?
No, George Johnson -- and I think he just died this last year. I think. I don't like to say things like that unless I'm sure.
